name: steven-mods

plugins.name: route-beacon
plugins.description: Shows which AI route this session is on (Claude, OmniRoute free, OpenRouter paid, local) and toasts when it changes.

plugins.name: halt-guard
plugins.description: Asks Proceed/Cancel before a send, a share, a payment or a force push while you are at the keyboard.

plugins.name: brain-reflect
plugins.description: /remember <rule> saves a standing rule into the second brain with bin/brain remember, never CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: connection-beacon
plugins.description: Status line with how many connections need you; /connections lists them with the fix; /owner <panel> says who keeps a Command Deck panel alive.

plugins.name: paste-desk
plugins.description: /paste shows the one Terminal line that reconnects this Mac and the short list only you can do.

description: Steven's own Claude Code mods: route beacon, HALT guard, brain reflect, connection beacon, paste desk.
